title: deps(plugin-detail): raise the @objectstack/spec floor to ^18.0.0-next.3, the first release that exports SelectOptionKind (objectui#12946)
body:
Fixes #12946

Clause-②: no

`@object-ui/plugin-detail` now declares `@objectstack/spec` `^18.0.0-next.3`, up from `^18.0.0-next.1`. One manifest line, one lockfile importer specifier line regenerated by pnpm, one patch changeset, and a one-sentence edit to a pending changeset (see the Acceptance notes). No source file moves.

## Why

Since PR #12922 (`8392f74a`) the published `dist/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.d.ts` imports the type `SelectOptionKind` from `@objectstack/spec/data`. `18.0.0-next.3` is the first release that exports it. The old range admitted `18.0.0-next.1` and `18.0.0-next.2`, so the declared claim was wider than the published types can compile against. The scheduled Spec Range Floors run on `main` (run `39096968879`, conclusion failure) went red for this, and `changeset:publish` runs the same gate before `changeset publish`, so the next release was refused until this floor moved.

## Measured (exit codes captured before any pipe)

Build: `turbo run build --filter=./packages/*` under the verify lock, 39 of 39 tasks successful, VERDICT command-exit 0.

- `pnpm check:spec-floors` BEFORE the edit, on the built `main` tree: exit 1, one finding, `floor-too-low` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`dist/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.d.ts` references `SelectOptionKind` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, which `18.0.0-next.1` does not export). No other finding.
- The same command AFTER the edit, at head `5ffc1a61`: exit 0, and with `-- --cross-check` exit 0 (65 entry points, the import and require halves agree). The gate fetched `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` `./data` and `./ui` from the registry.
- Absence control for "the earlier releases lack it": a grep of the fetched `18.0.0-next.1` and `18.0.0-next.2` tarballs for `SelectOptionKind` finds nothing, while the same grep for `ServiceObject` finds it in the `next.2` tarball; the installed `18.0.0-next.3` carries `SelectOptionKind` in `dist/data/index.d.ts`.
- Lockfile: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false` exit 0. The diff is the manifest line and the importer's `specifier` line (`^18.0.0-next.1` to `^18.0.0-next.3`). That importer's `version` line stays `18.0.0-next.3(ai@7.0.65(zod@4.6.7))`, and no resolution of any package moved. A later `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 ("Lockfile is up to date").
- `check:installed-pin-claims` 0, `check:lockfile-integrity` 0 (VERDICT clean, 1774 resolutions on both sides), `check:lockfile-dedupe` 0 (VERDICT deduped), `check:changeset-claims` 0 (1 changeset read), `pnpm changeset:check` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0.
- Neighbours that read manifests or changesets, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`.
- Ten script suites that read manifests, the lockfile or the floor gate: 10 files, 319 tests passed (`check-spec-range-floors`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-lockfile-integrity`, `check-lockfile-dedupe`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `workspace-peer-dependency-edges`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `doc-version-claims`, `spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265`).
- Follow-up commit `284c09e9` (changeset text only, two files; the manifest and the lockfile are untouched, so the floor, lockfile and install readings above stand from `5ffc1a61`): `node scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` 0 and `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0 (2 changesets read), `pnpm changeset:check` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` 0.
- CI's farm is not re-run locally; its check-runs are the evidence for the rest.

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/spec` is the only `@objectstack/*` range `@object-ui/plugin-detail` declares (in `dependencies`). Its peer and dev dependencies name only workspace `@object-ui/*` packages and tooling, so nothing else moves with it.
- Every other hit for `18.0.0-next.1` under `scripts/`, `packages/plugin-detail/`, `docs/`, `content/` and the CI workflows is left as it was. They are fixtures in the `check-spec-range-floors` and `check-changeset-no-major` suites, example ranges in script header comments, or dated changesets. `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` quotes no range literal on purpose and points at the manifest. The only live assertion about this package's floor is the gate itself.
- The pending `18.0.0-next.3` note, `.changeset/12873-spec-next-3.md`, said every package keeps its `@objectstack/*` range, which already admits it. The range does admit `next.3`, but once this PR and PR #12945 land two packages no longer keep theirs, and the released CHANGELOG would have printed that sentence beside two floor raises. Commit `284c09e9` rewrites that one sentence and nothing else in the file (front matter and every other line are unchanged). It now names `@object-ui/app-shell` (objectui#12943) and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (objectui#12946) as the exceptions, which declare `^18.0.0-next.3`, and keeps `@object-ui/types` at `^18.0.0-next.2`. It also lists `@object-ui/components` beside `@object-ui/types` as declaring `^18.0.0-next.2`, which the old parenthesis left out (read from the workspace manifests at this head). The `Changeset Overwrite Report` check is report-only: it lists a changeset this change did not add and prints the declaration at base beside the one now, here identical, and names correcting prose on purpose as a legitimate case. This package's own changeset now says it is one of the two exceptions.
- `check-changeset-presence` reports no changeset owed, because `dependencies` is not one of the manifest fields it counts as a published contract. The card asks for one, so one is added.
- objectui#12943 (PR #12945) moves app-shell's floor and regenerates app-shell's importer line in the same lockfile; this PR regenerates plugin-detail's. The two edits are on different lines. Whichever lands second regenerates with pnpm if the lockfile conflicts.
- No governed surface is touched (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the four paths the PR touches: NOT GOVERNED).
